contract_fields.summary: The paper asks whether a resorcinol-derived porous carbon electrode stays stable over long cycling. It prepares the electrode from resorcinol and formaldehyde, tests it in 1 M H2SO4 at 1 A/g in three identical cells, reports 210 F/g at 1 A/g and 92 % retention after 5000 cycles, and explicitly leaves rate capability at 5 A/g unmeasured. The conclusion is limited to stability at 1 A/g over 5000 cycles.
